title: Replace the standing length instructions with an information-density rule
action: Per D6 replace every STANDING instruction about how long a skill body may be with one information-density rule: a body line must change agent behavior; a line that does not belongs in references/. No number, no threshold, nobody measures it. Wording is yours within that shape. Four edits. (1) skills/bee-writing-skills/SKILL.md:41 -- the Regrowth law currently reads 'a new learning lands in the knowledge bundle or references/ by default; edit the body itself only for a load-bearing invariant, and only if it still fits the recorded budget in scripts/skill-body-budget.json -- over budget, trim the body first (one in, one out)'. KEEP the useful half (default to the knowledge bundle or references/), DROP the budget clause and the one-in-one-out clause, since scripts/skill-body-budget.json no longer exists. (2) skills/bee-writing-skills/SKILL.md:40 -- 'Body <200 lines preferred; overflow to exactly one level of references/' falls under D6 as well: a line ceiling is the same instinct as a byte ceiling. Keep the overflow-to-references guidance, drop the number. (3) skills/bee-evolving/SKILL.md:90-92 -- the Learning placement paragraph ends 'within its recorded budget in scripts/skill-body-budget.json -- over budget, trim first'; same replacement. (4) skills/bee-writing-skills/references/provenance.md -- REMOVE the row at :14 (Body budget ceiling + ratchet enforcement | skill-token-diet D1/D6 | scripts/skill_budget_fence.mjs is the blocking half), and REWRITE the row at :12 (Regrowth law ... within budget, one in one out | skill-token-diet D5) so it documents the new rule and cites repo decision 8f63adb4 instead. Governing decision text, for your wording: 'A size ceiling on instruction text is never a standing law in bee. A diet is a deliberate one-off optimization event that leaves no permanent gate behind.' AFTER the edits run the regen chain IN THIS ORDER: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs, then node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply, then node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write, then node scripts/impact_registry.mjs --write. Never hand-edit .claude/, .agents/, .codex-plugin/, .claude-plugin/ or .bee/bin/ -- they are rendered.

truths: No skill body instructs a reader to fit a byte or line budget
skills/bee-writing-skills/SKILL.md and skills/bee-evolving/SKILL.md both state the information-density rule and still send new learnings to references/ by default
No live instruction text references scripts/skill-body-budget.json or scripts/skill_budget_fence.mjs

verify: node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check && node scripts/okf_instructions_fence.mjs && node scripts/run_verify.mjs --only test_lib_mirror,test_render_race && node scripts/impact_registry.mjs --check
